title: the 3644 question: three ledgers, one bogus zip, one vendor-hash-verified acquisition

question_3644.origin: the founder's brief: the physical board reports BIOS 3644 (ASUS B450-PLUS class)
hypotheses_ring12: H1 contaminated acquisition metadata (the ring-11 '3644' entry borrowed Gigabyte F67c's fields)
H2 board-model variant: 3644 lives in another ASUS product's ledger
evidence_this_ring: H1 PROVEN for the acquisition: the ring-11 asus_b450plus_3644.zip is a 240-byte HTML error page (no EOCD signature; sha256 22fd6e575be583a4)
H2 tested on the two TUF variants: 3644 in NEITHER ledger
H3 open — the 16/09 dump decides by fingerprints (version strings, PSP blob hashes, NVRAM defaults)

verdict: 3644 is absent from all three official ASUS AM4 B450-PLUS-class ledgers; no evidence it was ever published under any of the three product names
